title: Intake and baseline
requirement: Inspect received motherboard; inventory service parts and record initial symptoms.

title: Power fault isolation
requirement: Diagnose EPS seating; restore protected CPU power with fresh solver evidence.

title: Firmware recovery
requirement: Diagnose simulated firmware read failure; recover approved virtual firmware and repeat cold initialization.

title: Memory and storage qualification
requirement: Verify DDR5 training, PCIe and NVMe enumeration, and data integrity after restart.

title: Thermal feedback repair
requirement: Resolve CPU fan tach feedback fault; verify cooling under bounded load.

title: Final recovery audit
requirement: Collect fresh power, POST, storage and thermal evidence after a complete cold restart.
